name: Sentinel of Nova Kai
summary: Surge, Counterattack that grows with its Objects, and once armed it stands guard again after attacking.

face.name: Sentinel of Nova Kai
face.flavor: The answering blow is the only one it has always prepared.

effect.text: This Entity's Counterattack increases by 1 for each Object assigned to this Entity.

keyword.name: Surge
keyword.rules: may attack the turn it enters the Front

vigil.text: The first time each of your turns this Entity attacks while it has an Object assigned, untap it after combat.
